name: Tsuioku no Kanata
source:
After confessing to her crush, she got a “Yes!”  
The protagonist, Ayase Natsumi, surrounded by kind friends, was at the peak of her life.  

But Natsumi had one worry: her senpai was troubled, yet never confided in her, leaving her unable to help.  

“If only I could see into people’s hearts…”  

As she muttered this on the rooftop, a voice suddenly spoke—  

“Shall I grant that wish for you?”  

And just like that, Natsumi gains the ability to read minds.  
This is the story of her and the people around her, navigating the chaos that follows.  

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21808]freem[/url]]
translation:
向喜欢的前辈告白后，她得到了“好啊！”的答复。
主人公绫濑夏美有一群温柔的朋友陪伴，正处在人生最幸福的时刻。

但夏美心中有一件烦恼：前辈明明遇到了困扰，却从不向她倾诉，让她无从伸出援手。

“要是能看透别人的内心就好了…”

她在屋顶上如此喃喃自语时，一个声音突然响起——

“要我替你实现这个愿望吗？”

就这样，夏美获得了读取心灵的能力。
这是她与身边的人一同应对随后种种混乱的故事。

[翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21808]freem[/url]]
